# Muscle Qualification Evidence Boundaries

## Status and Scope

This provisional reference covers the evidence-integrity correction under
F07 (#11791), within feedback matching epic #11784. It does not qualify a native
muscle model, contact law or captured motion. The calculation inventory and
publication approval remain blocked under the existing manual governance.

## Inputs and Performed Checks

`tour_matching.muscle_qualification.qualify_muscle_extensions` accepts muscle
parameter/provenance records and a declared anatomical scope. It runs the
existing anatomy-coverage and parameter-validation checks. It receives no
native model, path geometry, state trajectory or independently verified replay
receipt. Parameter validity alone cannot demonstrate muscle path correctness,
moment-arm consistency, tendon equilibrium, activation trajectories or native
forward replay.

The lower-level geometry, finite-difference moment-arm, equilibrium and
activation audit helpers remain available for separately supplied evidence.
Their availability does not imply the parameter-only orchestrator ran them.

## Result Contract

The returned receipt retains actual parameter-audit outcomes and anatomical
scope. Path/wrapping, moment-arm, equilibrium and activation pass fields are
false because a pass has not been established. The native short-replay field
is `None`; absent observations are never replaced by zero or fixed pilot
residuals. Overall muscle qualification and independent validation remain
pending.

`NativeShortReplayReceipt` remains a compatible metrics container. Its default
status is `UNVERIFIED_NATIVE_REPLAY`: constructing a record neither executes
OpenSim nor verifies supplied values. Setting a status explicitly is not a
scientific certification. Genuine native receipts must be checked through the
governed F07/F08 evidence boundary with model, initialization, input,
runtime and numerical-policy identity. No new certification shortcut is added.

The existing `short_replay_duration_s` argument remains accepted for API
compatibility. It expresses a requested future experiment and produces no
runtime duration, step count or measurement. This change removes no executed
native replay because the prior orchestration performed none.

## Behavioral Evidence and Limits

The focused tests in `tests/opensim/test_muscle_cmc.py` require parameter-only
orchestration to return no native receipt and no unperformed audit successes.
A separate test verifies that a manually constructed metrics record is
unverified by default. Both fail against the prior fixed-pilot behavior and
pass after the guard; existing lower-level audit tests remain required.

These are software evidence-integrity tests. They do not establish physiological
parameters, complete state restoration, contact dynamics, full-horizon matching
or independent excitation replay. Those native model gates remain open.
